lines.en: Song Minwoo's blood dripped down, wetting the floor. My fist, drenched in blood, had grown numb. Song Minwoo occasionally choked up bloody foam, but he neither opened his eyes nor spoke. His battered body seemed to have given up on repairing itself.
Han Sooyoung muttered.
“You scary bastard······ You beat a werewolf with your bare hands?”
The nearby werewolves had already fled or had just been beheaded by Han Sooyoung. I looked down at Song Minwoo and said.
“He's not dead yet.”
Looking at him no longer shook the [Fourth Wall]. I didn't know whether my trauma had been resolved, but at least I must have developed some resistance to those old memories.
[The constellation ‘One Who Overcomes the Late Trials’ offers encouragement at the sight of you.]
[The constellation ‘One Who Overcomes the Late Trials’ wishes to bestow their own stigma upon you.]
A stigma? Seriously?
This bounty scenario hadn't even been commissioned by a single constellation, so receiving a stigma as a reward was a real surprise.
Of course, I was grateful.
[You have acquired the stigma ‘Self-Rationalization (自己合理化)’.]
[The constellation ‘One Who Overcomes the Late Trials’ smiles contentedly at you for inheriting the stigma.]
[You will now possess a defense mechanism that will not yield to any trauma.]
Grateful······ I stood blankly for a moment, dumbfounded.
[The constellation ‘Prisoner of the Golden Headband’ clutches his stomach with laughter.]
Self-Rationalization?
What was so special about this that it even needed hanja beside it?
Who are you making fun of right now?
Han Sooyoung asked.
“Hey, aren't you going to kill that?”
“Huh?”
“That thing.”
Only then did I look at Song Minwoo, dangling in my grip.
Should I kill him?
He belonged to a non-human species anyway, so killing him wouldn't violate my no-killing restriction.
[The sponsor of ‘Wolfman Song Minwoo’ glares at you.]
The constellations in Bihyung's channel would be pleased if I killed him, too.
[A considerable number of constellations yearn for your revenge.]
I looked down at Song Minwoo for a moment, then released my grip on his collar.
“Let's go.”
“What? Seriously?”
“Yeah.”
[Some constellations are disappointed in your hypocrisy.]
[A considerable number of constellations question your judgment.]
[The constellation ‘Secretive Plotter’ observes your judgment.]
“You're really not killing him? That bastard must have quite a few coins.”
“Yeah.”
“Then can I kill him?”
“Go ahead. But you'll regret it.”
“Regret it?”
I merely shrugged, then walked past her.
Straight in the direction the pack of werewolves had come from.

Their main base was probably at the end of this route. And if my guess was right, the [Meteorite] that had helped them mutate into werewolves would be there, too. I absolutely had to collect the [Meteorites] to prepare for the disaster scenario.
Following a little behind, Han Sooyoung glanced at me to gauge my reaction, then seemed to be up to something.
Suddenly, the footsteps seemed to multiply, then all receded behind us. Straight toward Song Minwoo.
Avatars······.
Right.
I knew you'd do that, Han Sooyoung.
I let her indulge her greed.
In return for her turning a blind eye to my hypocrisy.
And a moment later.
“Fuck! What the hell is this!”
Han Sooyoung convulsed and let out a terrible scream.
I knew what messages would be appearing in her head.
Probably something like these.
[The killing of the grade-6 non-human species ‘Wolfman Song Minwoo’ has alerted Demon King ‘Andras’ to the killer's existence.]
[Demon King ‘Andras’ will remember the incarnation body that dealt the final blow in the killing of his subordinate.]
[Demon King ‘Andras’ will order his subordinates to hunt down the incarnation body that dealt the final blow.]
[Final Blow Dealer: Han Sooyoung]
Han Sooyoung stared at me in dismay, and, as expected, I grinned back.
“I told you you'd regret it.”
Song Minwoo had been a subordinate of ‘Andras’, one of the 72 Demon Kings.
The 72 Demon Kings.
‘Constellations’ weren't the only powerful beings in the Star Stream.
Some refused to become subscribing constellations in the sky and still roamed planets in their own flesh. ‘Demon Kings’ were one kind of these supremely powerful beings.
“You're a real fucking bastard.”
Just as constellations created incarnations, Demon Kings sought out ‘subordinates’, usually fallen incarnations who had chosen the path of a non-human or demon species.
Demon King ‘Andras’, who occupied a low position in the caste of the 72 Demon Kings.
One of his symbols was the ‘wolf’.
Andras's blessing was precisely why Song Minwoo had possessed such remarkable [Physical Regeneration].
Han Sooyoung stammered.
“How, how could you do this to me······.”
“Don't worry. Someone I knew was cursed by a Demon King just like you were, and he didn't die right away.”
“You call that comforting?”
Come to think of it, Han Myungoh had been cursed by Demon King ‘Asmodeus’······ I wondered what had happened to him by now. Was he still alive?

“Look on the bright side. ‘Andras’ isn't even a particularly high-ranking Demon King. Becoming a Demon King's enemy will win you favor with the Absolute Good faction, so you'll get more donations, too. It's all good.”
“I'm not interested in those archangels, okay? Besides, the sponsor I'm going to choose doesn't get along with angels!”
Why, were you going to choose a Demon King, too?
I nearly asked that without thinking, but something felt strange, and I closed my mouth again.
······What had she just said?
“The sponsor you're ‘going to choose’ doesn't get along with angels?”
Perhaps noticing my gaze, Han Sooyoung covered her mouth.
“Damn it, this mouth of mine······.”
“Don't tell me you still don't have a sponsor?”
It wasn't impossible. I didn't have a sponsor, either.
In fact, most of the people who had muddled their way through the first scenario probably had no sponsor. More precisely, they ‘hadn't had any options to choose from’.
But learning that someone as powerful as Han Sooyoung still had no sponsor was unexpected.
“It's not that I couldn't choose. I chose not to. Isn't picking an option right at the start weirder? You only get to choose once.”
“Well, that's true.”
If you could postpone <Sponsor Selection>, it was best to do so.
There were plenty of good constellations, and depending on your performance in the scenarios, it could quite literally be a case of ‘out with the junker, in with the Mercedes’.
The <Sponsor Selection> event occurred once immediately after the first scenario, then regularly just before ‘disaster scenarios’ began.
Since the fifth scenario was a ‘disaster scenario’, Han Sooyoung would probably be able to take part in the upcoming second <Sponsor Selection>.
I feigned ignorance and asked.
“So who are you planning to choose? Do you have a constellation in mind?”
At my words, Han Sooyoung looked confident.
“You'd be shocked if you knew. They've already shown an interest in me.”
“Who is it?”
Had the ‘Great Sage, Heaven's Equal’ appeared as an option?
“Ever heard of the ‘Abyssal Black Flame Dragon’?”
······The what Black Flame Dragon?
[The constellation ‘Abyssal Black Flame Dragon’ watches your reaction.]
I hesitated briefly before answering.
“Oh, right. Good thinking. That's a good sponsor.”

The ‘Abyssal Black Flame Dragon’ had presented himself as the sponsor of ‘Delusion Demon Kim Namwoon’ in some rounds of the original novel. Since the Delusion Demon had been one of the supporting characters who rivaled the Steel Sword Emperor for the title of strongest, it really wasn't a bad choice.
[The constellation ‘Abyssal Black Flame Dragon’ looks at you with complicated feelings.]
This bastard had said he wasn't interested in me anymore. What a weird fucker.
Han Sooyoung's eyebrow twitched at my indifferent tone.
“You look like something's bothering you. Who's your sponsor, anyway, that you're acting so prickly?”
“No, it's nothing. I was just jealous.”
“Really?”
“Really.”
[The character ‘Han Sooyoung’ is using ‘Lie Detection Lv.1’.]
[The character Han Sooyoung has confirmed that the statement is false.]
“Do you have a fucking death wish?”
The ‘Abyssal Black Flame Dragon’, of all constellations.
I could only hope she got that sponsor.
They would get along wonderfully.
[A constellation who likes harems cheers on the chemistry between you and ‘Han Sooyoung’.]
[You have received a donation of 500 coins.]
Han Sooyoung grimaced, apparently having heard the same message as me.
“What the hell now······.”
Unfortunately, that harem constellation's wish wouldn't come true.
Han Sooyoung and I would be together only for the next 10 days.
We were cooperating briefly, but that didn't change the fact that she was a dangerous enemy.
“Looks like we're here.”
A little later, we reached what we presumed was the werewolves' main base.

Near Bangbae Station. The scent of blood drifted through the forest of buildings packed tightly together. A battle seemed to be underway; werewolf howls and human screams came from the distance. Han Sooyoung said.
“Looks like we're a little late. Someone else got here first?”
There were no guards in sight, as though all the werewolves had gone somewhere.
A little farther in, we found a farm much larger than the one Assistant Manager Yoon had set up.
‘Coin farms’—something unique to a ruined world.
From now on, I would encounter these sights until I was sick of them.
Perhaps the coin harvest was already over. No one in the cages was still alive.
Walking ahead of me, Han Sooyoung suddenly pinched her nose.
“Ugh, what's that?”

Beyond the cages, in the werewolves' living quarters, an even more horrific sight awaited us. Severed human thighs hung from rubber cords. Like pork hanging in a butcher's shop, cuts of meat whose purpose was all too clear.
[The exclusive skill ‘Fourth Wall’ offsets your mental shock.]
I had only ever read scenes like this in text. This was my first time seeing one in person, too.
There was a set way for an ordinary human to evolve into a non-human species.
Cannibalism (食人).
In other words, devouring their own kind.
Han Sooyoung spat out a curse.
“These fucking bastards······.”

Most members of non-human species evolved by accident. Usually, those who failed to clear the ‘Find Food’ sub-scenario took this path, but once they embarked on the non-human path, none of them could stop.
Those whose species had changed no longer felt remorse about killing humans.
“So it looks like even you get angry when you see something like this.”
“Of course. Who wouldn't?”
“The other Prophets told me all you cared about was using what you knew to rule the world.”
“Who said that?”
Han Sooyoung snorted and added.
“That's as ridiculous as those plagiarism accusations.”
“Rule the world? Sure, that'd be nice. But stopping its destruction is my first priority. You think I gathered the <Apostles> for nothing?”
“Those <Apostles> were all scum.”
“They were scum to begin with! Is that my fault?”
Bang! Bang! Bang! Bang!
We instinctively held our breath. Thunderous reports came from ahead. I could hear flesh bursting like fruit pulp.
Baaang!
There was no mistaking that sound: gunfire (銃聲).
But shouldn't the military have been wiped out already?
We ran around the buildings toward the gunfire.
Even if some of the military remained, fighting werewolves with guns was absurd. But the sight that soon unfolded before us made that absurd idea perfectly reasonable.
A mountain of werewolf corpses lay before our eyes.
The skin of every corpse struck by a bullet had turned pitch-black. Han Sooyoung and I spoke almost simultaneously.
“Elemental bullets.”
“They put holy power into the bullets······?”
In the distance, I saw people aiming guns at us.
They were all armed with modern rifles, but strangely, every one of them wore a prison uniform.
Han Sooyoung grabbed my collar, tense.
“Hey, remember when I told you there was a bitch like you over by ‘Seodaemun Prison’?”
“Yeah.”
“That's that bitch's group.”
A masked woman stood where Han Sooyoung pointed.
She had covered most of her body, including her face. Without the long hair hanging below her shoulders, even her gender would have been difficult to tell.
“She's the leader. Judging by how fast she's grown and what she does, she's definitely a former reader, but I can't see any information about her.”
I see. These were the people from ‘Seodaemun Prison’ Han Sooyoung had mentioned······.
But why hadn't a group that powerful appeared during the struggle for the throne?
Looking at the heap of werewolves, Han Sooyoung spoke.
“They're wanderers, too. Pretty powerful wanderers······ And now they've just become the most powerful wanderers I know.”
A woman carrying a gun began walking straight toward us from the other side.
She wasn't the leader Han Sooyoung had pointed out.
I drew [Unbreakable Faith], and Han Sooyoung prepared [Avatar]. That was when the approaching woman's gun barrel moved.
I ducked in alarm, but her barrel was aimed at the mountain of werewolf corpses.
Ratatatat!
The corpses collapsed beneath the barrage of bullets.
And something hidden beneath them was revealed.
“What's that?”
A glowing stone roughly 2 meters wide and long.
One of the meteorites we were searching for to stop the ‘disasters’.
The [Yellow Meteorite] was there.
As expected, that ‘meteorite’ seemed to have been the source of the werewolves' power.
The woman, who had been looking at the meteorite with us, slowly turned toward me and spoke.
“You're Kim Dokja, aren't you?”
Looking closely, I noticed that she seemed quite a bit older.
Perhaps not in her forties, but at least in her mid-to-late thirties, judging by the scattered wrinkles on her face.
She knew me? How?
I was a little taken aback, but I kept my composure and decided to sound her out.
“You seem to be mistaken. My name is Yoo Joonghyuk. Kim Dokja is the name of the bastard I hate most.”
“······Yoo Joonghyuk?”
“That's right. So tell your former reader to stop getting cocky. If you don't know what that means, just go deliver the message first.”
I glanced aside to find Han Sooyoung staring at me in disbelief. I gave her a look. She would know what to do next. The woman spoke.
“I already know you're Kim Dokja. Stop the unnecessary lies.”
[The character ‘Han Sooyoung’ has confirmed that the statement is true.]
Han Sooyoung nodded at me.
This woman had come knowing exactly who I was.
“Our king has said this meteorite is to be entrusted to you.”
One surprise after another.
As if knowing me weren't enough, now she was offering us the meteorite for free······.
“Who are you people?”
“We serve the ‘King of Wanderers’.”
“Is that masked woman over there your king?”
The woman nodded.
I looked at the tall masked woman standing some distance away. As I studied her, something felt familiar. But there was something strange.
“A king······ You don't seem to have a flag.”
“Our king does not concern herself with such trifling objects.”
······Trifling objects?
The woman continued.
“Our king asked me to tell you this: ‘We will handle the disaster in the north. But we leave the other four disasters to you.’”
Before I could ask anything, the woman left us with those words and turned away, as though she had said all she had to say.
Han Sooyoung shouted.
“Hey! What the hell are you talking about all of a sudden? You can't just leave without explaining!”
Ignoring her shouts, the woman walked away with her back to us.
Han Sooyoung looked at me and asked.
“What the hell······ Do you know that woman, too?”
“How would I?”
I immediately activated [Character List].
[This person is not registered in ‘Character List’.]
[You can view this person's information by updating ‘Character List’. Would you like to update it?]
Apparently, another update cycle had already come around.
I nodded.
[The update is complete.]
[Some characters are being added to the list's database.]
Then a window appeared.
<Character Information>
Name: Cho Youngran
Age: 37
Constellation Sponsor (背後星): First Spiritualist of Joseon (朝鮮第一術士)
Exclusive Attributes: Escaped Model Prisoner (General), Executor of Justice (Rare)
Exclusive Skills: [Prison Escape Lv.3], [Patience Lv.6], [Time of Execution Lv.3], [Marksmanship Lv.4]······.
Stigmas: [Shapeshifting Lv.2]
Overall Stats: [Constitution Lv.30], [Strength Lv.34], [Agility Lv.36], [Magic Power Lv.28]
Overall Evaluation: An overall evaluation is currently in progress.
●A starter pack is currently in effect.
●A growth package is currently in effect.
Well, look at that. The First Spiritualist of Joseon?
[The constellation ‘First Spiritualist of Joseon’ looks at you warily.]
To think there was already a woman with ‘Jeon Woochi (田禹治)’ as her sponsor.
Moreover, she even had a class in the ‘Executor’ line, a very good attribute, though a little below ‘Judge’.
If a subordinate was this powerful, just how powerful was that ‘king’?
I immediately looked at the tall woman.
[This person's information cannot be viewed through ‘Character List’.]
[This person is not registered in ‘Character List’.]
The moment my eyes met those of the woman behind the mask, a sharp pain shot through my head.
I instinctively looked away.
My heart raced.
The [Fourth Wall] didn't shake, but I knew instinctively.

If I'd kept looking at her, a tremor even greater than the one I'd experienced upon meeting Song Minwoo would have come. I had [Self-Rationalization], but I still wasn't sure how well it worked, and I didn't want to take a reckless risk.
Han Sooyoung asked with concern.
“Hey, what's wrong?”
“······It's nothing.”
A reaction from the [Fourth Wall] meant this was someone who had significantly affected my life in reality.
In other words, that woman was someone I knew.
But there was only one person in this world who had inflicted a greater trauma on me than Song Minwoo.
I see······ You survived, just as I thought.
But I hadn't expected you to be in Seoul.
The reason she had been able to build such a large force.
The reason they wore prison uniforms.
If it was her, it all made sense.
Soon, the wanderers began to move.

They formed ranks and returned exactly the way they had come. A march without the slightest hesitation. In the discipline evident in every detail, I sensed a loyalty I had never seen in any other group.
At the head of the column, their leader commanded them.
A woman with neither a crown like the Tyrant King nor dragon robes like the King of Beauty.

I looked at the ruins they had swept through. Destroyed coin farms, and the survivors they had rescued. Blankets and daily necessities, apparently handed out by the wanderers themselves, lay beside the survivors. The survivors watched the departing group of wanderers with awe.
I had forgotten.
You didn't necessarily need a flag or a seat on a throne to become a king.
Even in this kingless world, there was still a king.
A little later, I was examining the [Yellow Meteorite] they had left behind.
The yellow meteorite.
Also called a moonstone (月長石), this meteorite had actually been a moon of a star drifting through another dimension.
Indeed, it was exactly as I had read in the book.

The tingling magic power I felt whenever I touched it, the faint light seeping from its opaque interior, even the prominent white stripes across the meteorite. This yellow meteorite definitely held one of the powers that could oppose a disaster.
How long had I been at it? A system message sounded.
[The ‘Moonstone’ wishes to provide you with evolutionary power on a higher plane.]
I refused the meteorite's offer.
Then the meteorite withdrew its power.

The moonstone essentially possessed the power of the night, so the non-human species must have received that power, too. The cannibals who received the power of the night had probably been able to evolve into werewolves, a higher non-human species.
[The ‘Moonstone’ feels an inexplicable affinity with you.]
But this meteorite's true purpose wasn't merely to evolve non-human species. Even hundreds of werewolves couldn't stop the coming disaster.
A thousand or so would help, of course, but then the swarming non-human species and Demon Kings' subordinates would bring about another disaster.
“Feels like I'm doing volunteer work for the first time in ages······ Hey, figure anything out?”
While I examined the meteorite, Han Sooyoung had been tending to the survivors lying nearby. It was so unlike her that I was a little surprised, but sure enough, it was a scheme to earn coins.
[Some constellations of the Absolute Good faction are moved by the good deeds of ‘Han Sooyoung’.]
Since she had even made an enemy of a Demon King, her donations would have been inflated beyond their usual amounts.
Human duality truly was profound.

A constellation from the Absolute Good faction might even appear who could give the Abyssal Black Flame Dragon a run for its money. With <Sponsor Selection> approaching, Han Sooyoung was probably beginning to test the waters, too. I looked around and said.
“Avatar really is useful.”

Dozens of avatars were quickly cleaning up the area. The non-human corpses burned fiercely, and the horrific cages and human butcher shops were dismantled. I wondered if she really wanted coins badly enough to work with blood pouring from her nose like that, but······.
Wiping away the blood, Han Sooyoung asked.
“So, when are you going to tell me?”
“Tell you what?”
“About earlier.”
I realized her question wasn't about the meteorite.
“That's still bothering you?”
“How could it not?”
There were two ‘former readers’ of a kind she knew nothing about.
And there seemed to be some connection between those two former readers.
For Han Sooyoung, the so-called ‘last former reader’, it was bound to be troubling.
“Someone I know, probably.”
“······You said you didn't know her earlier.”
“Not the woman who spoke to us. The group's leader you mentioned.”
“The King of Wanderers?”
I nodded and said.
“She's not a former reader. To be precise, she's probably never even read the original novel.”
“What? Then how does she know what's in it?”
“I told her myself.”
Han Sooyoung looked as though she had been struck in the back of the head with a hammer.
“You told someone else that boring story? Why the hell would you?”
“I needed something to talk about when I met her.”
After a brief pause, I continued.
“That was the only thing I had to talk about.”

Perhaps because the mood had darkened a little, Han Sooyoung hesitated just as she was about to press me further. She probably had plenty to ask. Who that woman was, and what relationship she had with me.
After a brief silence, Han Sooyoung spoke again in a casual tone.
“I don't know what your relationship with her is, but is it okay to leave her alone? If more people besides us know the future······.”
I understood her concern. But it would be fine.
At least she was a person with principles, and she wouldn't recklessly use knowledge of the future to wreak havoc.
I tapped the moonstone and spoke.
“This is more important. I'm going to wake it up now.”
“What? This?”
Han Sooyoung looked at me as though questioning my sanity.
“You're saying you're going to wake a ‘disaster’ right now?”
“Why are you so surprised? You've done it yourself.”
During the <Night of the Prophets>, Han Sooyoung had incited the Prophets to awaken the fire dragon ‘Lesser Igneel’.
“Hey! That was only a lesser disaster. This is······.”
“This isn't a disaster.”
“······Then what is it?”
“Looks like you've been slacking off on your plagiarism. Don't you remember? Do you really not know what comes out of this when the scenario starts?”
After glaring at me for a moment, Han Sooyoung turned on her smartphone and began reading the text file of her novel.
“Oh······ This, don't tell me······.”
“Found it now? Looks like you copied it well.”
“Shut up. But is it okay to do this when the main scenario hasn't even opened yet? What if you get hit by another probability bombardment?”
“That won't happen over something like this.”
“You've already gotten on the intermediate dokkaebi's bad side······.”
“That's why we're taking care of it while he's gone.”
By now, he would be busy getting reprimanded at the Bureau.
“We're going to start pouring magic power into this. By my calculations, about ten hours should be enough for it to hatch. I'll do four hours, and you do six.”
“Why do I have to do six hours?”
“Your Magic Power level is higher, isn't it?”
At that moment, the number of avatars roaming around dropped sharply.
Quick on the uptake, aren't you.
“Tell me honestly. What's your Magic Power level?”
“Do I have to tell you?”
“It's information we need to clear the scenario.”
[A clause of the ‘Temporary Pledge’ takes effect.]
Han Sooyoung's face twisted into a scowl.
Honestly, I was startled. Since she could operate dozens of avatars, I had assumed she was above level 40, but level 55······ That was almost at the scenario's limit.
Judging by her relatively low Constitution and Strength, she seemed to have poured every coin she'd had into Magic Power.
“We'll have to change it. Two hours for me. Eight for you.”
“Hey! That's unfair! And I'm already out of magic power.”
I asked Bihyung to open the [Dokkaebi Bag], then bought a few [Intermediate Magic Power Recovery Potions].
“Then drink these while you do it.”
“What are these?”
“Coin items.”
“······Your sponsor must be really generous. Is it okay to just give me things like these?”
“I'm the generous one.”
Han Sooyoung gave me a sidelong glare.
“You didn't put anything weird in them, did you?”
“I'll go first, then.”
I placed my hand on the moonstone and immediately began pouring magic power into it.
Thinking of the being that would awaken inside this meteorite ten hours later.
How long had I been asleep? I opened my eyes at the sound of someone waking me.
“Hey, get up, quick! It's starting to move!”
Han Sooyoung was shouting anxiously, her hand still on the meteorite.
Crack, craaack―

Fine cracks began to appear in the meteorite. It was similar to what had happened when the fire dragon's red meteorite broke apart. It wouldn't react as aggressively as that one······ But even so, a single wrong word could get us both killed here.
Rooooooar!
Dazzling light shot straight up from the moonstone, illuminating part of the dark night. A powerful being whose mere appearance was intimidating was stirring awake, curled up inside.

Fragments of the moonstone fell to the ground like a broken shell. A being with a flowing silver mane was hatching. If it had been a baby, we could have controlled it through ‘imprinting’, but the being emerging now was no such innocent creature.
[You have encountered a life-form from another world for the first time in scenario history.]
[Your affinity with otherworlders increases.]
[You have received 2000 coins as a reward.]
[You have received a bonus skill for smooth communication with otherworlders.]
[You have acquired ‘Otherworld Language Interpreter Lv.1’.]
I could sense Han Sooyoung swallowing hard beside me.
An encounter with an otherworlder was the prelude to the fifth scenario, so her tension was understandable.
It was completely different from the scenarios so far.
In the fifth scenario, even a small mistake could make all of Seoul disappear.
[You are using the exclusive skill ‘Otherworld Language Interpreter Lv.1’.]
[The effect of the item ‘Amulet (護符) of the Imyuntar Species’ increases your comprehension of a particular language.]
The amulet I had obtained by killing the fire dragon would be useful from now on, too.
[Automatic interpretation begins.]
A voice came from inside the glowing moonstone.
“#%#$. ······Damn it, already?”

The enormous creature curled up inside the moonstone rose, grumbling. The silver mane covering his body brought a wolf to mind at first glance, but he was on an entirely different level from a mere werewolf. Above all, I knew his species.

「A body easily three meters tall. A ruling species of the otherworld ‘Chronos’, capable of transforming at night by drawing on the moonstone's energy. They are warriors of the wind, with monstrous endurance and the strength of giants.」
One of the five ruling species of Chronos.
“I am a great first wolf.”
「On Chronos, they are called the first wolves, ‘Imyuntar’.」
“An Imyuntar, ‘Lycaon’.”

As his growling breath echoed through the darkness, every presence nearby fell silent. His aura was so imposing that merely meeting his eyes made Han Sooyoung hide behind me. Of course, I didn't back away.
[Activating the exclusive skill ‘Character List’!]
<Character Information>
Name: Lycaon Isparang
Age: 371
Constellation Sponsor (背後星): Shadow of a Destroyed World
Exclusive Attributes: Noble Imyuntar (Hero), Survivor of Humiliation (Rare)
Exclusive Skills: [Way of the Wind Lv.9], [Advanced Weapons Training Lv.9], [Battlefield Roar Lv.8], [Sage's Insight Lv.4], [Steel Skin Lv.8], [Acting Lv.4]······.
Stigmas: [Guidance to Destruction Lv.1]
Overall Stats: [Constitution Lv.75], [Strength Lv.75], [Agility Lv.75], [Magic Power Lv.75]

Overall Evaluation: A member of one of the five ruling species of the destroyed world of Chronos. After losing his world, he threw himself into the Star Stream and became a scenario guide. He is characterized by eyes that always regard the world with deep regret.
As expected of a hero from another world, his skills and stats were outrageous.
An overall stat average of 75.
That even exceeded the current scenario's limit.
One punch would send most station representatives straight to their graves.
Lycaon's blue eyes looked down at me with apparent interest.
“Are you the ones who awakened me?”
I nodded.
“I see······ Then the time has finally come? Congratulations on clearing the tutorial scenarios, warriors of another world.”
Tutorial, my ass.
He seemed to be clumsily imitating a dokkaebi for dramatic effect. It was ridiculous.
There was no such thing as a tutorial in this world.
Every scenario was the real thing, and the dead could never return.
So how could there be anything like a ‘tutorial’?
“You who face destruction. First, I express my deepest regret that ‘disasters’ have come to your world.”
Lycaon spoke as he looked up at the sky.
The Great Hole occupying the sky above Seoul.
The enormous vortex, reminiscent of a black hole, grew a little larger with every passing moment. Lycaon must have seen that ‘Great Hole’, too, on the day his own world was destroyed.

Yoo Joonghyuk had?
Looking down at Yoo Joonghyuk's face, now greener than before, I suddenly had a lot to think about. Han Sooyoung, who had fled in terror, quietly returned and spoke to me.
“Hey, what's going on?”
Han Sooyoung poked my shoulder and pressed for an answer, but I didn't respond.
After thinking for a moment, I spoke to Bihyung.
‘Bihyung, open the Dokkaebi Bag.’
[See now? I told you I didn't set this up.]
‘Just open the bag.’
After checking my remaining coins, I located coin items that could treat Yoo Joonghyuk, one by one.

If someone was poisoned with Thousand Spirits Poison, simply taking [Ellain Forest’s Vital Force] wouldn't be enough to cure them. I quickly opened the text file and swiftly checked a few ingredients, then finished buying the items from the Dokkaebi Bag.
[You have purchased 1 ‘Midday Tryst’ item.]
[You have purchased 1 ‘Old Barbara's Branch’ item.]
[You have purchased 2 ‘Green Daltun's Horn’ items.]
[You have purchased 1 ‘Detoxifying Potato’ item.]
[You have purchased 2 containers of ‘Eintern Temple's Purifying Water’.]
[You have purchased 1 ‘Ellain Forest’s Vital Force’ item.]
[You have spent a total of 7370 coins.]
An unexpected favor that was costing me dearly.
I asked the nearby survivors for a small bucket, and once I had one, I lit the Magic Power Stove and poured in the ingredients. Han Sooyoung asked,
“What are you making?”
“An antidote.”
“So you decided to save him after all?”
I nodded and answered,
“I think this bastard came looking for me on purpose.”
“On purpose? Why?”
“I don't know either.”
“Maybe he came to ask for help? I don't think even Yoo Joonghyuk would come to kill you when he's been beaten to a bloody pulp.”
“There's no way Yoo Joonghyuk would do that.”
“How do you know?”
“I know. That's the kind of bastard he is.”
I crouched down and adjusted the stove's flame.

The flame blazed blue, and the contents of the bucket began to boil. Judging by its color and appearance, the dish would have suited a name like ‘Death Valley Goblin Offal Soup’. Horrific as it looked, this soup was an excellent antidote.
Han Sooyoung leaned on her knees and peered at the horrific dish as she spoke.
“But you know, was Yoo Joonghyuk really that bad a guy in Ways of Survival?”

“It occurred to me when I thought about it. If you look closely, Yoo Joonghyuk saved quite a lot of people and did good things too, didn't he? Sure, he did some psychopathic shit, but ultimately, wasn't he acting for the greater good? He was fighting to save the world. I hate to admit it, but he killed me because I was a villain.”
Thinking about it, Han Sooyoung wasn't entirely wrong.
I chuckled and said,
“You're awfully convincing, defending Yoo Joonghyuk after running even farther away than I did.”
“That's one thing, and this is another. All I'm saying is that you can't judge a person by just one side of them.”
That was unexpected, so I looked up at Han Sooyoung for a moment.
Han Sooyoung continued with a cool smile.
“Just like how, no matter how much you insist my work is ‘plagiarism’, it actually wasn't influenced by Ways of Survival at all.”
“······If you hadn't said that, you would've almost convinced me. What a shame.”
Despite what I'd said, the unexpected question left my thoughts a little tangled.
What kind of person was Yoo Joonghyuk?
Could I really say I knew the person called ‘Yoo Joonghyuk’ well?
Until just a moment ago, I could have answered confidently.
Because I was the only reader who had read all of Ways of Survival.
Yet as I watched the ingredients boiling in the soup, it somehow felt as though part of my answer had been diluted in the soup.
Was the ‘Yoo Joonghyuk’ I knew really all there was to ‘Yoo Joonghyuk’?
Before long, the soup was ready.
[The constellation ‘Demon-like Judge of Fire’ is moved by your good deed.]
[Constellations of the Absolute Good alignment who support your good deed nod.]
[You have received a donation of 3000 coins.]
It wasn't often I still came out at a loss after receiving donations. Damn it.

I took the soup and approached Yoo Joonghyuk where he lay. Han Sooyoung fetched a spoon from a nearby shop, and I used it to spoon the soup into his mouth. Han Sooyoung sneered as she watched me blow on the soup—puff, puff—to cool it.
“Here comes the devoted wife.”
“You want to do it?”
“No.”
Actually, even if she'd agreed, I wouldn't have handed it over.
Because a system message sounded every time I fed him a spoonful.
[The constellation ‘Demon-like Judge of Fire’ is moved by your good deed.]
[You have received a donation of 500 coins.]
Showering me with coins every time I fed him—this was an incredibly profitable business.
[The constellation ‘Demon-like Judge of Fire’ is moved by your good deed.]
[You have received a donation of 300 coins.]
I'd thought I was taking a loss, but it turned out to be an amazingly lucrative event.
It really did pay to be a good person.
But once ten spoonfuls had gone down like that, I gradually began to feel strange.
[The constellation ‘Demon-like Judge of Fire’ is moved by your good deed.]
[You have received a donation of 400 coins.]
······Was this punk really giving me these because she was moved by my good deed?
How long had I waited after feeding him the whole bowl?
Yoo Joonghyuk let out a faint groan and began opening his eyes.
His body was still a wreck, but the poisoning was gradually starting to subside. Seizing the opportunity, I took out an item.
[Using the item ‘Midday Tryst’.]
[Currently requesting the target's consent.]

[Midday Tryst] was an item that let you hold a one-on-one conversation with a chosen target for a set period. If I'd had a few more coins to spare, I would have learned the [Voice Transmission] skill, but I couldn't afford that yet, so I'd chosen this as the next best option.
[The target has agreed to communicate with you.]
[Beginning ‘Midday Tryst’.]
When I sent a message with Yoo Joonghyuk in mind, something like a small messenger window appeared before my eyes.
―Hey, can you hear me?
The connection was working.
There were three reasons I'd gone out of my way to buy this item.

First, Yoo Joonghyuk's tongue was paralyzed by the effects of Thousand Spirits Poison. Second, I wanted to avoid leaking unnecessary information to Han Sooyoung. The third was the most important: I didn't want to give Yoo Joonghyuk any more certainty that I could read his thoughts.
And the next moment, Yoo Joonghyuk's message appeared.
―Kim Dokja, head east right now.
